research: [spread] Line has moved toward Atlanta all week: 49ers opened -5 (Predictem, Oct 22; SBR lists a -4.5 open), reached -3 by midweek, and Covers' odds table lists 49ers -2.5 as of Oct 25. The slate's Falcons +3.5 is a full point better than the settled number and on the other side of the key number 3 (helps ATL).

[spread] Reverse line movement toward the underdog: DraftKings had 79% of bets on San Francisco but 55% of the money on Atlanta (Covers industry report, Oct 23), while the line fell. Sharp-vs-public split points to ATL (helps ATL).

[angle] Body clock and short week: SF played Monday night (beat Washington 23-17), then flies cross-country for a 1 PM ET kickoff that 'feels like 10 AM' (Predictem, Oct 22). Covers notes SF has played only one true road game in six weeks (Oct 21) (helps ATL).

[angle] SF's receiving corps is banged up: Mike Evans left Monday's game with Achilles tendinitis ('hopefully' plays, per Shanahan), Deebo Samuel and LB Garret Wallow out, Nick Bosa banged up (Predictem, Oct 22; SBR Oct 25 notes several receiving injuries) (helps ATL).
[angle] SF faded in the second half Monday: 300+ yards in the first half vs Washington but only three first downs and 72 total yards after halftime (Covers early leans, Oct 21) (helps ATL, mildly).

SF is 6-0; Purdy 14 TD, 2 INT, sacked on only 2.8% of dropbacks; 49ers first in EPA/play, success rate, 3rd-down rate (51.5%) and red-zone TD rate (85%); defense allows 18.3 ppg and 4.7 yards per play, both top four (Predictem, Oct 22) (helps SF).
Atlanta's passing efficiency ranks 29th, Penix has a 4.2% interception rate (31st) and Falcons QBs are sacked on 8.7% of dropbacks (Predictem, Oct 22) (helps SF).

Atlanta's run game averages 5.1 yards per carry (3rd), and Covers expects the Falcons to lean on Bijan Robinson to shorten the game; ATL ran on 24% of plays vs Chicago and had the 8th-best points per play that week (Covers, Oct 21) (helps ATL).

Atlanta's defense ranks near the top in pressure rate and QB hits while blitzing at the 4th-lowest rate, but has the league's lowest interception rate; top CB A.J. Terrell on IR since Week 2, LBs Deablo and Daniels hurt vs Chicago, CB Henderson questionable (Covers Oct 21; Predictem Oct 22) (mixed, slightly SF).
[spread] Falcons are 0-3 straight up and ATS at home this season and on a two-game skid (Predictem Oct 22; Covers Oct 21) (helps SF, but ATS records are priced per LESSONS).
Falcons games have averaged 56+ points with Penix starting and the last four went Over (SBR, Oct 25); total 49.5-50.5 (context only).
Expert split: Covers leans ATL +3.5 ('49ers could win this game but not cover that hook'); Predictem and SBR take SF -3/-3.5 with 28-20 / 28-24 projections (Oct 21-25).
games.reasoning: On the numbers SF is the better team, but the market has steadily moved from -5 to -2.5 with money (not tickets) on Atlanta, and the slate gives +3.5, a full point better than the close and through the key number 3 -- the slate-vs-market edge and underdog RLM are the two signals LESSONS says have held. The most surprising angle is SF's Monday-night-to-1 PM ET body-clock trip with a hobbled receiving corps. A line back up at SF -4 or a confirmed healthy Evans/Bosa with SF-side money would have made this a pass.

research: [spread] Line moved toward Tampa: Panthers -3.5 earlier in the week (Covers early leans, Oct 21) to -2.5 after Baker Mayfield was named the starter (Covers, Oct 25); Covers odds table lists -2.5 as of Oct 25. Slate Panthers -3 is a half point off the settled -2.5 (slightly helps TB at +3).

[angle] Mayfield returns from a dislocated thumb after missing three games, starting in a protective glove; Covers' Krest questions his accuracy with it (Covers, Oct 25) (cuts both ways: upgrade over the backup, but not 100%).

Tampa's 29th EPA/play, 25th scoring, 24th yardage and 28th red-zone ranks were built mostly with undrafted rookie Jalon Daniels at QB in Mayfield's absence (Covers early leans, Oct 21) (Mayfield return helps TB relative to those numbers).
[angle] Tampa is without WR Emeka Egbuka (team leader in catches, yards and TDs) and RT Luke Goedeke, both ruled out (Covers, Oct 25) (helps CAR).
Carolina's offense is 2nd in total offense, 3rd in first downs, 4th in scoring; Bryce Young leads the NFL in passing yards and ranks 2nd in PFF grade (Covers, Oct 21 and Oct 25) (helps CAR).

[angle] Matchup: Tampa's run defense is top three (2nd) but its pass defense is bottom 10, which suits Carolina's pass-first attack; Carolina's run defense is 27th, which suits Bucky Irving (Covers, Oct 21/25) (mixed).
[spread] Carolina has covered 13 of its last 21 games (+4.15 units, 18% ROI) (Covers, Oct 25) (helps CAR, priced).

Tampa has scored fewer than 20 points in four of its last five and gone Under in its last three non-OT games; Carolina Under in 3 of 4 (Covers, Oct 21); total 44.5, a low total that keeps the game near the number (context).
The two QBs have combined for more interceptions than TD passes (Covers, Oct 21) (variance, neutral).

Experts lean Carolina: Covers' Krest Panthers -2.5 (55% to cover), SBR AI Panthers 28-17; SBR ATS page took Bucs +3.5 (Oct 25). No betting splits found for this game (Covers industry report, Oct 23, has none).
Moneyline Panthers about -159/-180 vs Bucs +130/+150 (slate; SBR) (context).
games.reasoning: The market already moved a point toward Tampa on Mayfield's return, and the slate's +3 is only a half point better than the close, so there's no real line edge. Mayfield's return offsets Egbuka and Goedeke being out, and Carolina's strong passing numbers offset a bottom-10 Bucs pass defense being priced; projection lands Carolina by about 2.5, within a point of the number. Splits showing sharp money on either side would have tipped it.

research: [spread] Denver opened -7.5 and fell three points to -4.5 after Arizona upset the Rams (Predictem, Oct 24); Covers lists -4.5 as of Oct 25, matching the slate. Per LESSONS, a 3+ move makes the new number fair (neutral).

Denver is 4-2 but has been outscored on the season; its offense averages 5.6 yards per pass attempt, worst in the NFL, and gained only 168 yards in its OT win over Seattle (Predictem, Oct 24) (helps ARI).

[angle] Bo Nix and Jacoby Brissett rank 31st and 32nd in PFF big-time throw rate; Arizona is last and Denver second-to-last in explosive play rate (Covers, Oct 25) -- two offenses that struggle to build margins (helps ARI as the dog).
Denver's pass defense is 5th by EPA and allows a 56.5% completion rate, 2nd best (Predictem, Oct 24) (helps DEN).

[angle] Denver CB Pat Surtain II and S Talanoa Hufanga (both ankle) doubtful per Predictem (Oct 24); Covers (Oct 25) says Surtain practiced and could return -- conflicting, uncertain secondary vs Trey McBride (helps ARI if out).
Arizona allows 8.6 yards per pass attempt (last) and ranks 30th in pass defense EPA; averages 3.7 yards per carry; James Conner on IR, Jeremiyah Love questionable (Predictem, Oct 24) (helps DEN).
[spread] Arizona's home performance rates last in the league (TeamRankings via Predictem); it lost at home 31-7 to Seattle and 45-21 to Detroit (Predictem, Oct 24) (helps DEN).
[angle] Rest: Denver played last Thursday (beat Seattle in OT), so it has about 10 days; Arizona comes off a road upset of the Rams on normal rest (Predictem, Oct 24) (helps DEN).

[spread] Broncos 6-1 SU as road favorites since 2024 but 'haven't covered much on the road'; Under in Denver's last four road games and five straight with totals of 44 or lower (Covers Oct 25; Predictem Oct 24) (low total: points matter more; context only).
Predictive ratings put the teams about 9.5 points apart on a neutral field (Predictem, Oct 24) -- LESSONS: ratings disagreeing with the line are not an edge.
Experts split: Covers ATS pick Cardinals +4.5 (projected 22-19); Predictem DEN -4.5 (24-16); WagerTalk DEN -4.5 (23-13); SBR AI DEN 27-17 (Oct 24-25). No betting splits found.
games.reasoning: The line already dropped three points from -7.5 to -4.5, and the slate matches the close, so the number is treated as fair. Denver's rest and pass defense argue for the favorite, but its league-worst passing offense makes laying 4.5 hard, and LESSONS says to be harder on favorites; projection DEN by 4, inside the number by only half a point. A clear Surtain status or splits would have been needed to pick.

research: [spread] Line was Lions -3 at DraftKings on Oct 23 (Covers industry report) and -3.5 on Covers Oct 21 and Oct 25 and in the Oct 25 odds table; slate -3.5 matches the close. Total rose from 52.5 (Oct 21) to 53.5-55.5 by Sunday (neutral on the side).
[spread] Money on Detroit: DraftKings 58% of bets / 72% of handle on DET; BetMGM 56% of bets / 80% of handle (Covers industry report, Oct 23) (helps DET; sharp-leaning money on the favorite).
Green Bay allows 11.3 points per game and ranked 1st in defensive DVOA, with the top PFF coverage grade (Covers early leans, Oct 21); SBR (Oct 25) has it 4th in DVOA (helps GB).
Detroit's defense allows the 3rd-most points (29.6 per game), the highest EPA/play, ranks 25th in DVOA and allows 5.6 yards per play; 4th-highest EPA per rush allowed (Covers, Oct 21/25) (helps GB).
Detroit's offense is tied for the most points per game (32.8), 2nd in points per drive (3.09), but 23rd in first-quarter EPA/play (Covers, Oct 25) (helps DET overall).
[angle] Detroit is off a Week 6 bye, and C Cade Mays (wrist) and S Brian Branch (Achilles) return (Covers, Oct 25) (helps DET).
[angle] Green Bay RB Josh Jacobs returns (Covers, Oct 21); Jordan Love has 8.2 YPA and a 101.8 rating over the last three weeks (helps GB).

[angle] Green Bay ranks 30th in both pass-rush win rate and run-stop win rate (Covers, Oct 25) -- a weakness the DVOA number hides; Lions OC Drew Petzing knows Packers DC Jonathan Gannon from Arizona (helps DET).
[spread] Green Bay has covered three straight and won three straight by a combined 71-34, though two of those came against backup QBs (Covers Oct 21; SBR Oct 25) (helps GB, priced).
[spread] Detroit is 1-3-1 ATS; Lions Over in 13 of their last 18 and all five games this season (SBR Oct 25; Covers Oct 25) (helps GB, priced).
Experts: Covers early lean GB +3.5, game-day top pick DET first half -2.5; SBR ATS GB +3; SBR moneyline DET (Oct 21-25).
games.reasoning: The defensive numbers favor Green Bay, but the handle at two books is heavily on Detroit and the line ticked from 3 to 3.5, so the Packers' case is mostly priced ATS records plus a defense that is weak at the line of scrimmage. Projection DET by about 2.5 gives only a one-point edge on the hook, short of the bar. Underdog RLM toward Green Bay would have made it a pick.

research: [spread] Rams opened -7.5 (Predictem) or -6.5 (SBR) and fell to -4/-4.5 midweek and -3.5 by Oct 25 (Covers), matching the slate. A 3+ point injury-driven move: LESSONS says treat the new number as fair (neutral).
[spread] Splits: DraftKings 67% of bets and 75% of handle on Las Vegas; BetMGM 80% of spread money on the Raiders (Covers industry report, Oct 23) -- money with the move toward the dog (helps LV).

[angle] Rams WR Davante Adams out (ruptured hamstring); DL Kobie Turner and NT Poona Ford out; kicker Blake Grupe tore his ACL, so Brandon McManus is their third kicker of the season (Predictem, Oct 22; Covers Oct 25) (helps LV).
[angle] Puka Nacua listed questionable after missing Friday's practice (SBR, Oct 24-25); Predictem (Oct 22) said he was still available. Status unresolved at lock (this is the pass trigger).

The Rams are 2-4, last in the NFC West, after losing to Arizona as double-digit favorites; backing them over their last 22 games lost 9.35 units (Predictem Oct 22; Covers Oct 23/25) (helps LV, but those numbers were partly built with Adams).
Rams still 7th in offensive success rate/DVOA, allowed a 32.9% third-down rate and no TDs to Arizona; problems are turnovers, penalties and special teams (Predictem, Oct 22) (helps LAR).
Rams allowed the 2nd-highest EPA per dropback and rank 29th in pass defense DVOA over the past two weeks (Covers, Oct 25) (helps LV).
[spread] Las Vegas is 5-1 ATS and 3-0 ATS at home despite three straight losses (Predictem Oct 22; Covers Oct 25) (helps LV, priced).

Raiders under Klint Kubiak: Kirk Cousins 14 TD passes, 27 points per game, 3rd-highest dropback success rate over four weeks; but the run game is last in rushing success (Ashton Jeanty 313 yards on 98 carries) (Predictem Oct 22; Covers Oct 25) (mixed).
Raiders' defense is 30th in DVOA and allowed the highest EPA/play and success rate over the past four weeks; allows 27 ppg (Covers Oct 25; Predictem Oct 22) (helps LAR).
Experts split: Covers combo includes Raiders +3.5; SBR AI Raiders 27-24; SBR ATS Raiders +4.5; Predictem Rams -4 (27-20) (Oct 22-25).
games.reasoning: The line has already fallen four points on the Rams' injuries and the slate matches the close, so the number is fair; money is on the Raiders but it moved the line with it. Nacua's status, which would swing the Rams' offense, was unresolved, which is a pass trigger. Projection LAR by 3, half a point inside the number.

research: [spread] Seattle opened -2.5, total 42.5, with no line movement noted (Covers odds page; Covers, Oct 25); slate -2.5 matches (neutral).

[spread] Splits: DraftKings 70% of bets on KC but 60% of handle on Seattle; BetMGM 68% of bets KC, 50% of handle Seattle; KC is BetMGM's most-bet ATS team by tickets (Covers industry report, Oct 23) -- public on the dog, bigger money on the favorite, line flat (slightly helps SEA).
Kansas City is unbeaten (5-0 per SBR, Covers refers to a possible 'first loss of 2026') (helps KC).

[angle] Seattle, the defending champion, lost 17-14 at Denver on a Thursday short week after three turnovers despite outgaining Denver by 186 yards; it now has extra rest (Covers, Oct 25) (helps SEA).
Seattle ranks 2nd in defensive DVOA, has the 2nd-highest pressure rate, leads ESPN's pass-rush win rate (16 sacks, 30 QB hits) while blitzing under 24% (Covers, Oct 25) (helps SEA).

[angle] Mahomes' PFF grade falls from 90.6 when clean to 64.8 under duress; KC's 3rd-down success has dipped to 36.7% over three games, vs a Seattle defense allowing the 3rd-lowest 3rd-down rate (Covers, Oct 25) (helps SEA).
[angle] Kenneth Walker III, now with KC, returns to Seattle: 665 yards, 6 TD, 6.3 YPC through five games (SBR, Oct 25-26 page, pre-game content) (helps KC).
KC has allowed 39 catches to tight ends in five games, 2nd most (SBR) (helps SEA via AJ Barner).
Seattle RB Zach Charbonnet may return from a knee injury on limited snaps; George Holani led SEA backs with a 58% snap share last week (Covers, Oct 25) (neutral).
[spread] Seattle 7-2 SU since 2020 when favored by 3 or less at Lumen Field (Covers, Oct 25) (priced, history).
Weather: 40-47% chance of rain later, upper 40s-50s, light wind (Covers; SBR) -- not a factor per LESSONS.
Experts: Covers Logan Seattle ML; Covers AI 24-20 SEA; SBR Spector KC +2.5; Covers ATS piece KC +2.5 (Oct 25).
games.reasoning: A flat line with public tickets on KC and larger money on Seattle; Seattle's pass rush vs Mahomes under pressure and its extra rest are real, but a 2.5-point home favorite is close to fair and LESSONS warns against favorite picks and RLM toward favorites. Projection SEA by 3, half a point past the number, so a pass. A move to SEA -3.5 with the money, or to KC +3, would have changed it.
